appearance.title: Appearance

form.createDescription: Define a kind of leave and the policy it is granted under.
form.editDescription: Changes apply from now on. Balances already granted are left untouched.

fields.label: Name

fields.allowsCarryOver: Carries over into the next year

errors.duplicate: The code, the name or the report marker is already used by another leave type. Choose different ones.
errors.inUse: This leave type cannot be deleted while requests or balances still reference it. Deactivate it instead to retire it without losing the history.

delete.description: “{{label}}” will be removed for good. If it has already been used, deactivate it instead.

empty.title: No leave types yet

form.createDescription: Define a department employees can be assigned to.
form.editDescription: Changes apply immediately to everyone assigned to it.

fields.name: Name
fields.isActiveHint: An inactive department can no longer be chosen for new employees.

validation.codeTooLong: The code can be at most {{max}} characters.
validation.codeInvalid: The code may contain only letters and digits, separated by - or _.
validation.nameTooLong: The name can be at most {{max}} characters.
validation.descriptionTooLong: The description can be at most {{max}} characters.

errors.duplicate: The code or the name is already used by another department. Choose different ones.
errors.inUse: This department cannot be deleted while employees are still assigned to it. Move them to another department, or deactivate it to retire it without losing the history.

delete.title: Delete this department?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be removed for good. If employees are assigned to it, deactivate it instead.

empty.title: No departments yet
empty.description: Departments are the organisational units employees are assigned to and reports are grouped by. Add the first one to get started.

form.createDescription: Add a day the company is closed.
form.editDescription: Changes apply to the company calendar immediately.

fields.name: Name
fields.typeFixedHint: A fixed holiday recurs every year, on the same day and month.
fields.typeVariableHint: A variable holiday covers a single year; next year is entered as a new record.
fields.fixedDateHint: Only the day and the month are used for a fixed holiday; the year in the date is disregarded.
fields.validityHint: The years the holiday applies to, both ends inclusive. Leave both empty if it always applies; fill in the end year for a holiday that has been repealed.
fields.isNationalHint: Turn off for a day off the company decided on rather than one set by law.

validation.nameTooLong: The name can be at most {{max}} characters.
validation.descriptionTooLong: The description can be at most {{max}} characters.
validation.startDateInvalid: The start date is not valid.
validation.endDateRequired: Choose the end date. For a one-day holiday, choose the same date.
validation.endDateInvalid: The end date is not valid.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
validation.yearOutOfRange: The year must be between {{min}} and {{max}}.
validation.validToBeforeValidFrom: The end year cannot be before the start year.

errors.duplicateFixed: A fixed holiday already falls on that day and month, in an overlapping range of years. Choose another day, or narrow the validity range.
errors.duplicateVariable: A variable holiday with this name already starts on that date.

delete.title: Delete this holiday?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be removed from the calendar for good, past years included. If the holiday was real and has since been repealed, set its end year instead of deleting it.

empty.title: No public holidays yet
empty.description: Public holidays are the days the company is closed and that are not deducted from anyone's leave. Add the first one to get started.
